statement.text: Conjecture Let $p_1,p_2,p_3,\ldots$ be a sequence of points in ${\mathbb R}^d$ with the property that for every $i \ge d+2$, the points $p_{i-1}, p_{i-2}, \ldots p_{i-d-1}$ are distinct, lie on a unique sphere, and further, $p_i$ is the center of this sphere. If this sequence is periodic, must its period be $2d+4$?

title: A conjecture on iterated circumcentres
